avgPreviousExecutionMs.description: Output only. Average execution ms of previous runs. Indicates the job ran slow compared to previous executions. To find previous executions, use INFORMATION_SCHEMA tables and filter jobs with same query hash.

stagePerformanceStandaloneInsights.description: Output only. Standalone query stage performance insights, for exploring potential improvements.

stagePerformanceChangeInsights.description: Output only. Query stage performance insights compared to previous runs, for diagnosing performance regression.

tableChangeInsights.description: Output only. Performance insights for table-level attributes that changed compared to previous runs.
